```yaml
name: Merge Queue Cleanup
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cleanup-merge-queue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Get UNMERGEABLE PRs from merge queue
        id: get_unmergeable
        run: |
          # Get all PRs in merge queue that are marked as UNMERGEABLE
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/merges --jq '.[] | select(.status == "UNMERGEABLE") | .number' > unmergeable_prs.txt
          echo "unmergeable_prs=$(cat unmergeable_prs.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
      - name: Remove UNMERGEABLE PRs and comment
        if: env.unmergeable_prs != ''
        run: |
          for pr_number in $(echo "${{ env.unmergeable_prs }}" | tr '\n' ' '); do
            echo "Processing PR #$pr_number"
            
            # Remove from merge queue
            gh api -X DELETE repos/${{ github.repository }}/merges/$pr_number
            
            # Post comment on PR
            gh pr comment $pr_number --body "This PR was automatically removed from the merge queue because it became unmergeable. Please rebase your branch to resolve conflicts and add this PR back to the queue."
            
            echo "Removed PR #$pr_number from merge queue and commented"
          done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
